title: AnnounceProcessor mutates gradient before TOFU key acceptance
description: Security review while implementing 4vqc found AnnounceProcessor.process updates gradient_table immediately after signature/IID validation but before checking the IID's pinned TOFU public key and pin-table capacity. A valid attacker key that collides on the 64-bit IID can therefore mutate/insert routing state even though the announce is subsequently rejected as KEY_MISMATCH; a first-seen announce rejected because the pin table is full also leaves a gradient. Complete all trust/admission checks before any routing-state mutation and add negative tests proving rejected announces leave the gradient table unchanged.
